commands.name: board.list
commands.description: List the boards in KanZen, e.g. "what boards do I have".

commands.name: board.read
commands.description: Read a KanZen board with its columns and cards, e.g. "what is on my work board". Without a board it reads the open one.

board.description: Board name; leave out for the open board

commands.name: card.list
commands.description: Find cards on a KanZen board, e.g. "what is overdue" or "what is in the doing column".

board.description: Board name; leave out for the open board

text.description: Words to look for in card titles and descriptions

limit.description: Most cards to return, at most 50; 20 if left out

commands.name: card.add
commands.description: Add a card to a KanZen board, e.g. "add a card to call the plumber to my to do column". The person approves it before it appears.

column.description: Column name; leave out for the board's first column

board.description: Board name; leave out for the open board

commands.name: card.move
commands.description: Move a KanZen card to another column, e.g. "move the plumber card to done". The person approves it before it moves.

card.description: The card's title, or part of it

board.description: Board name; leave out for the open board

commands.name: task.capture
commands.description: Capture a task in KanZen from one line, e.g. "remind me to call mum tomorrow at 6pm" or "pay rent every month on the 1st". Dates, repeats, #board, @label and p1-p4 are read from the text; it goes to the Inbox unless a board is named. The person approves it before it appears.

text.description: The task in one line, with any date or repeat

board.description: Board name; leave out for the Inbox

commands.name: task.complete
commands.description: Mark a KanZen task done, e.g. "I paid the electricity bill". A repeating task moves to its next date. The person approves it first.

task.description: The task's title, or part of it

board.description: Board name; leave out to look on every board

commands.name: task.defer
commands.description: Move a KanZen task to another day, e.g. "push the report to next Friday", or park it for someday. The person approves it first.

task.description: The task's title, or part of it

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or a phrase like "next Friday"

someday.description: Park the task for someday instead of a date

board.description: Board name; leave out to look on every board

commands.name: task.snooze
commands.description: Snooze a KanZen task's reminder, e.g. "remind me about the plumber in an hour". The person approves it first.

task.description: The task's title, or part of it

for.description: How long: 10 minutes, 1 hour, or tomorrow at 09:00; 1 hour if left out

board.description: Board name; leave out to look on every board

commands.name: task.query
commands.description: List KanZen tasks across every board, e.g. "what do I have to do today" or "what is overdue".

view.description: Which tasks; today if left out

limit.description: Most tasks to return, at most 50; 20 if left out

commands.name: habit.list
commands.description: List the habits tracked in KanZen with today's status and streaks, e.g. "how are my habits going".

commands.name: habit.checkin
commands.description: Check in a KanZen habit, e.g. "I went for a run today" or "skip meditation today". The person approves it first.

habit.description: The habit's name, or part of it

date.description: Day as YYYY-MM-DD; today if left out

skip.description: Mark the day skipped instead of done

undo.description: Clear the day instead of marking it done

commands.name: proposal.status
commands.description: Check KanZen changes waiting for approval, e.g. "did my card get added". Give a proposal_id for one change, or nothing for all that wait.

proposal_id.description: The proposal_id that card.add or card.move returned
